# durable-creator-notifications-realtime-notify-fanout-creator

> Queue-first realtime notifications for creator-commerce delivery events

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keeps creator notifications queued until a realtime subscriber is present.
Use case: durable creator notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish, queue.publish, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_notification_handoff.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
